integrity: The all-order statement follows from a complete repeat-gap and greedy-arch proof. Exhaustive finite tests confirm small orders; no extrapolation from tests is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Proved for binary de Bruijn cycles of every order n>=3, not q-ary cycles or arbitrary universal cycles.
Cyclic cuts are interpreted as linear words of exactly one cycle length; scattered subsequences do not wrap.
No enumeration of the relative frequency of the two cycle types, and no independent scientific audit.
title: A two-type circular subsequence-universality law for binary de Bruijn cycles
